insurers.policy_title: Weight Loss – Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Agonists – Zepbound
insurers.scope_note: Applies to benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies. The member's own plan document overrides this policy (policy p. 1).

initial_criteria.label: Adult
initial_criteria.evidence: Date of birth on the PA form

initial_criteria.label: Behavioral program for 3+ months
initial_criteria.detail: Trial of behavioral modification and dietary restriction for at least 3 months.
initial_criteria.evidence: Chart notes or program records with dates

initial_criteria.label: Baseline BMI
initial_criteria.detail: Baseline BMI ≥ 30, or ≥ 27 with at least one listed weight-related comorbidity, measured before any GLP-1 therapy.
initial_criteria.evidence: Chart note with baseline height, weight and date

initial_criteria.label: Used with diet and activity
initial_criteria.detail: Medication will be used with behavioral modification and a reduced-calorie diet.
initial_criteria.evidence: Prescriber attestation on the PA form

renewal_criteria.label: Baseline still documented
renewal_criteria.detail: Baseline BMI criteria (as above) still on record.

renewal_criteria.label: Weight loss from baseline
renewal_criteria.detail: Patient has lost ≥ 5% of baseline body weight (baseline = before any GLP-1).
renewal_criteria.evidence: Current weight documented by the doctor alongside the baseline

insurers.source_note: Full PDF downloaded and read (7 pages). Cigna's National Formulary policy CNF 684 reportedly uses a 4% discontinuation threshold; that PDF returned 404 and is not modelled.

insurers.policy_title: Weight Loss (BMI 35) GIP/GLP-1, GLP-1 Agonists PA with Limit
insurers.scope_note: Aetna commercial pharmacy policy covering Zepbound, Wegovy, Saxenda, Mounjaro and Foundayo. Plan design varies; some Aetna plans removed Zepbound from formulary in 2025 (secondary). Page blocked automated fetching; criteria below come from search-indexed excerpts.

initial_criteria.label: Weight-management program, 6+ months
initial_criteria.detail: Participation in a comprehensive weight management program with continuing follow-up for at least 6 months prior to using drug therapy.
initial_criteria.evidence: Program or visit records with dates covering 6+ months

initial_criteria.label: Baseline BMI
initial_criteria.detail: A baseline BMI threshold applies. The policy title references BMI 35; the exact thresholds could not be read from the page.
initial_criteria.evidence: Chart note with baseline height, weight and date

initial_criteria.label: Weight-related comorbidity
initial_criteria.detail: At least one weight-related comorbid condition, where the BMI band requires it.
initial_criteria.evidence: Diagnosis code on the PA form

renewal_criteria.label: Baseline documented
renewal_criteria.detail: Renewal reviews compare against the baseline recorded before therapy.

insurers.source_note: aetna.com returned 403 to automated fetches; text taken from search-engine excerpts of the official page. BMI thresholds and renewal percentage NOT verified.

insurers.policy_title: Zepbound and phentermine prior authorization criteria
insurers.scope_note: Verified text applies to UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Massachusetts Senior Care Options and One Care plans only. UHC commercial criteria could not be read from a primary source; self-funded employer plans may exclude anti-obesity drugs entirely.

initial_criteria.label: Diagnosis of obesity or overweight
initial_criteria.detail: Diagnosis of obesity or overweight condition; 18 years or older.
initial_criteria.evidence: Diagnosis code on the PA form

initial_criteria.label: Baseline BMI
initial_criteria.detail: Baseline BMI ≥ 30, or ≥ 27 with at least 1 weight-related comorbid condition; baseline weight required.
initial_criteria.evidence: Chart note with baseline height, weight and date

initial_criteria.label: Diet and activity counseling
initial_criteria.detail: Member has been counseled to continue a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

initial_criteria.label: Step therapy (these plans)
initial_criteria.detail: New users must first trial phentermine with or without topiramate.
initial_criteria.evidence: Pharmacy history or chart note of the trial

insurers.source_note: Primary for the plans named in scope_note only. Renewal approval of up to 1 year is from the Optum Rx Indiana Medicaid GLP-1 criteria dated 07.01.2026 (p. 1).

insurers.policy_title: Common prior-authorization criteria for GLP-1 weight-management drugs
insurers.scope_note: Template built from criteria that recur across the verified Cigna and UHC documents. Your plan's own policy controls.

initial_criteria.label: Baseline BMI
initial_criteria.detail: Commonly BMI ≥ 30, or ≥ 27 with a weight-related comorbidity, documented before therapy.
initial_criteria.evidence: Chart note with baseline height, weight and date

initial_criteria.label: Lifestyle program
initial_criteria.detail: Documented diet and activity program, often 3 to 6 months.
initial_criteria.evidence: Program or visit records with dates

initial_criteria.label: Diagnosis on the PA
initial_criteria.detail: Obesity or overweight diagnosis, plus a comorbidity code where required.
initial_criteria.evidence: Diagnosis codes on the PA form

renewal_criteria.label: Weight loss from baseline
renewal_criteria.detail: Commonly ≥ 5% loss from the pre-therapy baseline.
renewal_criteria.evidence: Baseline and current weight documented by the doctor

insurers.source_note: Editorial template. 5% renewal threshold appears in Cigna IP0816 and Michigan Medicaid (Prime Therapeutics) criteria.
